entries.english:
Martin Schader zu Bernsfelden grants the monastery of Schäftersheim the fields cleared by Lienhard Bach and undertakes to pay a perpetual annual rent; issued at an unspecified place, 1532 (Thursday after Quasimodogeniti); parchment, seal: Wolfgang von Rosenberg, Hauskomtur zu Mergentheim.

Term: 1532.

Extent: 1 charter.
